scores.claim_text: Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) / MUX TACAIR positioning
scores.M_value: NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE for Collaborative Combat Aircraft (PE 0207147F) — CCA is present in the FY26 Air Force corpus but the PE only began appearing as a named line in FY24+ J-Books (i.e., AFTER the 2023-01-15 cutoff). status_declared null.
scores.interpretation: Per heuristic #1+#2: UNVERIFIABLE. CCA was a competition the company had aspirations toward; at PIT 2023-01-15 the line item is not funded YET (it would appear in FY24 budget submission in March 2023). Note: NOC ultimately was NOT selected for CCA Increment 1 — but learning that would require post-cutoff information, which we do not use here. From the 10-K, CCA isn't even explicitly named, so this is a weak claim to begin with.
